title: KestrelCare Trip Allowance Card by Vehicle Program
content:
| Vehicle program on the covered vehicle's purchase order | Daily trip allowance on a KestrelCare trip interruption reimbursement |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified, Kestrel Factory Certified | 150.00 USD (premium trip allowance) |
| Kestrel Certified, Kestrel Certified Plus | 125.00 USD (certified trip allowance) |
| any other vehicle | the plan's trip interruption per-day amount |

**Rule.** The daily trip allowance of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts trip interruption reimbursement follows the vehicle program on the covered vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order: a vehicle sold as Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified receives the premium trip allowance, a vehicle sold as Kestrel Certified or Kestrel Certified Plus the certified trip allowance, and any other vehicle the plan's trip interruption per-day amount.

*Hypothetical:* 3 trip days on a Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle are paid at 150.00 a day, 450.00; on a Kestrel Certified vehicle at 125.00 a day, 375.00.
